notes.title: Development Blog: A Different Path
notes.content:
Hello there!

It’s been more than a month since we welcomed 2025, and it’s been 4 months since we decided to take a different path for Rootmare. We have been testing the Game to the Public, within specific Events, to gather feedback. So in the last few months, we have changed, revised, and improved our Game after careful considerations. Here are some details of what we've done:

[olist]
[*] Changing the Title from [u][b]“Akarmaut: Rootmare”[/b][/u] to a simpler yet still powerful one: [u][b]Rootmare[/b][/u]
[*] Changing the Main Story, which is now focusing on Beauty Industry as the Theme.
[*] Changing the Setting from School/Campus to Beauty Product Facility, on a Remote Island.
[*] Improving all the Mechanics for better Gameplay (which includes the 3C, how the Zombie works, and how the Objective works).
[*] Revising and improving all the Characters for better Narrative (for the Full Game).
[/olist]
We will be back with more updates, and we hope that we can provide a Steam Public Demo soon so everyone can get a taste. Please support us by putting Rootmare into your wishlist and share our Game to others!

Cheers!

/The Root Team

notes.title: Rootmare Event Recaps. The World of Nightmare Continues to Expand in 2025!
notes.content:
2024 has been a busy year for the Rootmare team. We had the opportunity to showcase our game at several gaming events throughout the year, including: 

BAPAREKRAF Game Prime 

IC FEST 

Gamers to Gamers (G2G) 

GAMEBERGIDIK Bandung 

These events provided valuable opportunities to connect with passionate gamers, gather valuable feedback, and generate excitement for Rootmare. We're grateful for the support and enthusiasm we received from the gaming community at each event.
